articles.title: ifo Institut: Mehr Unternehmen planen laut ifo-Umfrage mit höheren Preisen
articles.teaser: Wegen des Irankriegs und der Sperrung der Straße von Hormus steigen die Preise für Treibstoffe und Gas. Die betroffenen Unternehmen wollen das an die Kunden weitergeben.
articles.image_title: ifo Institut: LEUNA, GERMANY - MARCH 17: In this aerial view the Leuna industrial chemical park, with TotalEnergies oil storage tanks, stands illuminated at twilight on March 17, 2026 in Leuna, Germany. The Leuna facility depends on petroleum and natural gas, the prices of which for both have risen dramatically since the outbreak of the U.S.-Israeli conflict with Iran. The chemical industry in Germany was already under severe stress, with current output well below capacity. The Leuna park includes a TotalEnergies oil refinery and a Dow polyethylene plant, among many other chemicals products producers. (Photo by Sean Gallup/Getty Images)
